Tributes To Language Heroes
2014-02-22T00:02:21+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/tributes-to-language-heroes-12468

Awami League President Sheikh Hasina and the party leaders pay their respects at the Central Shaheed Minar in the capital in the early hours yesterday marking International Mother Language Day. Photo: Sk Enamul Haq, Anisur Rahman, Palash Khan

Sometime later, BNP Chairperson Khaleda Zia and the party leaders pay theirs. Photo: Sk Enamul Haq, Anisur Rahman, Palash Khan

Chiefs of the armed forces follow suit. Photo: Sk Enamul Haq, Anisur Rahman, Palash Khan

A tiny tot brought to join the crowd paying tribute. Photo: Sk Enamul Haq, Anisur Rahman, Palash Khan

Central Shaheed Minar at its full glory and grandeur. Photo: Sk Enamul Haq, Anisur Rahman, Palash Khan

School children wait their turn near the monument. Photo: Sk Enamul Haq, Anisur Rahman, Palash Khan

Maimed Liberation War veterans honouring the Language Movement martyrs. Photo: Sk Enamul Haq, Anisur Rahman, Palash Khan

Sector Commanders Forum. Photo: Sk Enamul Haq, Anisur Rahman, Palash Khan

Dhaka University Vice-Chancellor AAMS Arefin Siddique. Photo: Sk Enamul Haq, Anisur Rahman, Palash Khan

Foreign diplomats in Bangladesh. Photo: Sk Enamul Haq, Anisur Rahman, Palash Khan
